messages:
Ivy (Marketing): FYI we have an erratum: a chart in yesterday's benchmark blog used an earlier config by mistake. Need a correction plan and press outreach asap.
Marcus (PR): Ack. Pause social and syndication now?
Nora (Comms): Paused all scheduled posts. Holding paid syndication.
Lina (Eng): Confirmed the chart used batch=16 not batch=8. I'll regenerate corrected graphs and CSVs now. ETA 90 mins.
Priya (Legal): We'll need a short correction blurb and a one-line explanation for press. Avoid any minimizing language.
Ethan (CEO): Can we prepare two quote options acknowledging the fix and reaffirming reproducibility commitments?
Ivy (Marketing): I'll draft correction language + two CEO quote options. Marcus, can you prepare outreach for reporters who ran pieces?
Marcus (PR): Yes. Will prioritize outlets that picked up the story. Drafting email now.
Lina (Eng): Uploaded corrected PNGs and CSV to the shared folder. Also added the exact run command: ```bash
./bench --model=rwd-2025 --seq=1024 --batch=8 --runs=3
```
Ivy (Marketing): Draft correction notice: "Correction: A chart in our benchmark used an earlier batch configuration. We have updated the chart and data; methodology and scripts are available for verification." Priya ok?
Priya (Legal): Language ok. Add link to raw CSVs and methods. Also include timestamp of correction.
Nora (Comms): Internal note for CS: brief explanation + suggested Q&A. Support-bot, please post to #support.
Support-bot: Posted correction notice to #support with link to assets.
Marcus (PR): Outreach: emailing reporters with correction, offering a quick call with Lina. Sending now.
Ethan (CEO): I'll pick the quote: short and accountable. "We corrected an error in our benchmark visuals and have published corrected data; reproducibility is core to our work." Approve to use.
Ivy (Marketing): Approved. Publishing correction banner on the blog now and replacing assets.
Nora (Comms): Social resume only after PR confirms major outlets updated. Marcus will advise.
Marcus (PR): I'll send a follow-up once reporters confirm they updated. ETA within 2 hours for top-tier confirmations.
Lina (Eng): Added a note to the repo README about the fix and included the commit hash.
Ivy (Marketing): Checklist: 1) Banner up, 2) Assets replaced, 3) Press outreach done, 4) Internal note posted, 5) Social paused until PR clears. All green from my side.
Ethan (CEO): Thanks team. Good transparent response.
Marcus (PR): One more thing 1: track any social mentions and flag misreports.
Nora (Comms): Will monitor.
Ivy (Marketing): Closing thread once Marcus confirms outreach status.
